name: 3D isometric blocks
description: Three.js isometric diorama on a transparent background, shot with a true-isometric OrthographicCamera: a base slab draws in, grid tiles pop up in a diagonal wave, rounded cubes drop onto seeded stacks that rise towards the centre, then a faceted accent gem lands above the tallest tower and floats; soft shadows, pastel/brand/mono palettes from the design tokens, seedable layout. Use for 'building / growth / platform' metaphors, tech and SaaS explainers, section openers and backgrounds for a headline (16:9 and 9:16).
